collection.title: Renault Megane Hatchback 2008 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Renault Megane Hatchback 2008 to 2016 will fit, this model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Bayonet arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Megane which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
